title: Tanvi Sharma Claims First BWF World Tour Title, Youngest Winner
indian_angle: Indian teenager Tanvi Sharma's victory marks a significant milestone for Indian badminton on the global stage.
summary: Teenager Tanvi Sharma secured her maiden BWF World Tour title in Chinese Taipei, winning the final in straight games and becoming the youngest champion in the tournament's history, after previously losing three finals.

summary: Glasgow officially passed the Commonwealth Games baton to India, with Ahmedabad set to host the centenary edition in 2030, marking a significant moment for Indian sports.
